summary: This class models the HPX Shortcuts feature for Android mobile automation. It inherits from SmartFlow and provides comprehensive methods for managing shortcuts including creation, editing, deletion, and execution. The class uses a Page Object Model pattern with string-based locators passed to driver methods. Notable patterns include: dynamic locator generation using f-strings for parameterized elements (copies, colors, two-sided options), consistent timeout and exception handling parameters across all methods, extensive use of wait_for_object for element synchronization, and methods that return WebElement objects or boolean values for verification. The class handles multiple screens in the shortcuts workflow including main shortcuts screen, edit screens for print/email/save destinations, settings screens, confirmation dialogs, and running status screens. It also includes integration with external services like Google Drive sign-in.
